title: Ministerial definition of partial linkage differentials
answer: the Minister's definition is the Income Tax (Determination of Partial Linkage Differentials) Regulations 2003 (ק"ת 6227, amended 2005, ק"ת 6377), read with s.3(ה6): linkage on part of the sum, by part of the index rise, above the index rise, or for part of the period is partial, and is interest (TX2-18)
notes: TXI-05 Conditions and the Terms row 'הפרשי הצמדה חלקיים' still say the Minister's definition was not found (open question 1); tax-tier2-other.md TX2-18 (2026-10-25) has it. Closed in Phase A, so TXI-05 was not edited; the lead may point TXI-05 to TX2-18.

title: Securities losses against bank-deposit interest
answer: no offset; s.92(a) lets a capital loss be offset only against capital gains and betterment and, for a securities loss, interest or dividends on securities, and s.92(b) carries the rest forward against capital gains only; the Tax Authority guide states the same list and names deposit interest only for business losses (TXI-17)

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים

phase_b: Read s.92 in full in the Tax Authority's Ordinance PDF and the 2025 guide's loss sections (printed p.58: 'הפסד הון ניתן לקזז כנגד רווח הון ... או כנגד שבח במכירת מקרקעין'; printed p.55: business losses against 'רווחים מריבית בפיקדונות'). Closed; TXI-17 Conditions and Source updated.
notes: Instrument blockers 'loss-offset: blocked:TXI-OQ7' in wrappers/bank-deposit.json, current-account.json and savings-plan.json can be unblocked (a securities loss cannot absorb deposit interest). data/rules/txi-17.json notes cite TXI open question 7. The closure rests on the statute's closed list plus the guide; no sentence names deposit interest as excluded in words.

title: National Insurance and health on interest
answer: interest taxed under s.125C(b) or (c) is exempt from National Insurance contributions (NII Law s.350(a)(6)) and therefore from health contributions, whose base is the NI base; interest sent to marginal rates under s.125C(d) is outside that exemption's wording (TXG-27, TXG-34)
notes: TXI Summary (last bullet) and the worked-statement preamble still say NI and health on interest are open (outside my sections): the lead should update them. Answer rests on tax-general.md TXG-27 (btl copy of the NII Law) and TXG-34 (Health Insurance Law via the Wikisource mirror).
